entities.name: Damla Çakıroğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Damla Çakıroğlu is a Turkish female volleyball player. She is 179 cm (5.87 ft) and was the captain of the girls' youth national team and the women's junior national team. She played for TVF Fine Arts and Sports High School in Ankara. She wears number 1.
